- Computation docs (`first_day_rental_fee_amount`, `authorization_hold_amount`) carry no variation hint.
- Factor docs name only their operand ("the card deposit", "the day-rated first-day fee", "the rating day"). Each discount doc's "added together with any other first-day discount fraction … in one single step" carries the source's additive assembly without naming or pointing at any specific factor document. It is considered and not RED.
- No factor doc states which tier a customer falls on. The hold doc's "One reversal within the twelve months is enough; a reversal fourteen months back does not count" and the tenant doc's month-boundary cases are ladder boundaries with hypothetical dates. No doc mentions a returned-payment fee as a non-late fee, so the near-miss is left to the reader's reading of "late fee entries".
